metadata.description: Production-quality plugins: install the core (audits) and pqr-cycle; the rest are optional.

plugins.name: production-quality-ready
plugins.description: Audit owners and gates: code, security, reliability, release, commercial readiness and accessibility write evidence files; apply_gates.py decides release-candidate, production-ready and sellable. A PASS needs a command and a log.

plugins.name: pqr-cycle
plugins.description: bootstrap-project: writes a project's own work-cycle skills (start, review, close, verify, ship) and gates.json, self-contained, from the plugin's universal rules.

plugins.name: pqr-process
plugins.description: Optional process skills: spec, diagnose, grill, slice, map, triage, handoff, ship, improve.

plugins.name: pqr-website
plugins.description: audit-website: SEO, Core Web Vitals, cookies and links of a public website.

plugins.name: pqr-desktop
plugins.description: drive-app-window: drive a native desktop window (Windows) to prove a change.

plugins.name: pqr-ui-system
plugins.description: ui-system: OKLCH tokens and the data-ui contract of a design system; writes UI code.
